#!/bin/sh
set -eu

SCRIPT_DIR="$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")" && pwd)"
ENGINE="$SCRIPT_DIR/apply-discord-nfqws2.sh"

# The old body below is kept only as a disposable-root regression oracle.
if [ -z "${KD_TEST_ROOT:-}" ] || [ "${KD_ALLOW_TEST_ROOT:-0}" != 1 ] || [ "${KDN_ENGINE:-}" != legacy ]; then
  PYTHONPATH="$SCRIPT_DIR/tools/router${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}"
  export PYTHONPATH
  exec python3 "$SCRIPT_DIR/tools/router/route_switch.py" service "$@"
fi

usage() {
  cat <<'EOF'
Usage:
  sh set-service-route.sh discord-tcp   direct|zapret|vpn --yes-router [apply options]
  sh set-service-route.sh discord-voice direct|zapret|vpn --yes-router [apply options]
  sh set-service-route.sh discord       direct|zapret|vpn --yes-router [apply options]
  sh set-service-route.sh youtube       direct|zapret|vpn --yes-router [apply options]
  sh set-service-route.sh telegram      direct|vpn|ws|unmanaged --yes-router [apply options]

discord-tcp covers Discord domains (TCP/TLS and QUIC), discord-voice covers
Discord Voice/STUN UDP ports, and discord switches both at once. telegram
covers Telegram domains and DC networks (it has no zapret mode); "ws" carries MTProto through the
router's WebSocket relay; "unmanaged" removes the project's Telegram rules and
leaves Telegram to the user's own routing.

The routes of the other services and the Discord UDP settings (--wide-udp,
--udp-strategy) are read from the current managed state and preserved; pass
--narrow-udp, --wide-udp or --udp-strategy to change them. "vpn" is a
user-facing alias for the engine route "vless".

A standalone deployment (installed with --standalone-zapret, no XKeen) stays
standalone: vpn and Telegram routes are refused there and --core is ignored.
Pass --integrated to switch the deployment to XKeen.

Examples:
  sh set-service-route.sh discord-voice zapret --core auto --wan-interface eth3 --yes-router
  sh set-service-route.sh youtube direct --core auto --wan-interface eth3 --yes-router
EOF
}

[ "$#" -ge 2 ] || {
  usage >&2
  exit 2
}

service="$1"
requested_mode="$2"
shift 2

case "$service" in
  discord|discord-tcp|discord-voice|youtube|telegram) ;;
  *)
    echo "ERROR: service must be discord-tcp, discord-voice, discord, youtube or telegram." >&2
    usage >&2
    exit 2
    ;;
esac

if [ "$service:$requested_mode" = "telegram:zapret" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: Telegram has no zapret mode; use ws, vpn or direct." >&2
  exit 2
fi

case "$requested_mode" in
  direct|zapret) route_mode="$requested_mode" ;;
  vpn|vless) route_mode="vless" ;;
  unmanaged|off|ws)
    [ "$service" = "telegram" ] || {
      echo "ERROR: only telegram can be $requested_mode." >&2
      exit 2
    }
    case "$requested_mode" in ws) route_mode="ws" ;; *) route_mode="unmanaged" ;; esac
    ;;
  *)
    echo "ERROR: mode must be direct, zapret or vpn." >&2
    usage >&2
    exit 2
    ;;
esac

status_output="$(sh "$ENGINE" --status)"

status_value() {
  printf '%s\n' "$status_output" |
    awk -F= -v key="$1" '$1 == key { print $2; exit }'
}

require_route() {
  case "$2" in
    direct|zapret|vless) ;;
    *)
      echo "ERROR: cannot determine current $1 route; no changes made." >&2
      exit 1
      ;;
  esac
}

current_discord_tcp="$(status_value discord_tcp_route)"
current_discord_voice="$(status_value discord_voice_route)"
current_youtube="$(status_value youtube_route)"
current_telegram="$(status_value telegram_route)"

require_route "Discord TCP" "$current_discord_tcp"
require_route "Discord Voice" "$current_discord_voice"
require_route "YouTube" "$current_youtube"
case "$current_telegram" in
  direct|vless|ws|unmanaged) ;;
  # The removed Telegram Zapret route has the same Xray rules as direct.
  zapret) current_telegram="direct" ;;
  *) current_telegram="unmanaged" ;;
esac

next_discord_tcp="$current_discord_tcp"
next_discord_voice="$current_discord_voice"
next_youtube="$current_youtube"
next_telegram="$current_telegram"
case "$service" in
  discord)
    next_discord_tcp="$route_mode"
    next_discord_voice="$route_mode"
    ;;
  discord-tcp) next_discord_tcp="$route_mode" ;;
  discord-voice) next_discord_voice="$route_mode" ;;
  youtube) next_youtube="$route_mode" ;;
  telegram) next_telegram="$route_mode" ;;
esac

# Keep the current Discord UDP settings unless the caller overrides them:
# the engine applies options in order, so "$@" (after these) wins.
case "$(status_value udp_range)" in
  wide) set -- --wide-udp "$@" ;;
  narrow) set -- --narrow-udp "$@" ;;
esac
current_udp_strategy="$(status_value udp_strategy)"
case "$current_udp_strategy" in
  flowseal|legacy) set -- --udp-strategy "$current_udp_strategy" "$@" ;;
esac

# A standalone deployment stays standalone (A5): the switch adds
# --standalone-zapret, drops "--core X" (the engine refuses it there; the
# panel always passes --core auto) and leaves the recorded Telegram route to
# the engine. --integrated switches the deployment to XKeen explicitly.
deployment_mode="$(status_value deployment_mode)"
deployment_choice=""
for arg in "$@"; do
  case "$arg" in
    --integrated) deployment_choice=integrated ;;
    --standalone-zapret|--without-xkeen|--no-xkeen) deployment_choice=standalone ;;
  esac
done
if [ -z "$deployment_choice" ] && [ "$deployment_mode" = "standalone-zapret" ]; then
  deployment_choice=standalone
  for target_route in "$next_discord_tcp" "$next_discord_voice" "$next_youtube"; do
    if [ "$target_route" = vless ]; then
      echo "ERROR: this router uses the standalone Zapret deployment without XKeen; vpn routes need XKeen." >&2
      echo "       Pass --integrated to switch the deployment to XKeen." >&2
      exit 2
    fi
  done
  if [ "$service" = telegram ]; then
    echo "ERROR: Telegram routes need XKeen; this router uses the standalone Zapret deployment." >&2
    echo "       Pass --integrated to switch the deployment to XKeen." >&2
    exit 2
  fi
  next_args=""
  skip_next=0
  for arg in "$@"; do
    if [ "$skip_next" -eq 1 ]; then
      skip_next=0
      continue
    fi
    case "$arg" in
      --core) skip_next=1; continue ;;
      --core=*) continue ;;
    esac
    next_args="$next_args $(printf '%s' "$arg" | sed "s/'/'\\\\''/g; s/^/'/; s/\$/'/")"
  done
  eval "set -- --standalone-zapret $next_args"
fi

echo "Service routes: Discord TCP=$next_discord_tcp, Discord Voice=$next_discord_voice, YouTube=$next_youtube, Telegram=$next_telegram"
if [ "$deployment_choice" = standalone ]; then
  exec sh "$ENGINE" \
    --apply \
    --discord-tcp-route "$next_discord_tcp" \
    --discord-voice-route "$next_discord_voice" \
    --youtube-route "$next_youtube" \
    "$@"
fi
exec sh "$ENGINE" \
  --apply \
  --discord-tcp-route "$next_discord_tcp" \
  --discord-voice-route "$next_discord_voice" \
  --youtube-route "$next_youtube" \
  --telegram-route "$next_telegram" \
  "$@"
